data.name: Advanced.TrackSpecTip
data.value: Track specification, for example c=0-79:h=0-1, c=0-79/2:h=0, or c=0-79:h=0-1:hswap.

data.name: Advanced.SpeedTip
data.value: Positive speed or period, for example 300rpm, 200ms, 200000us, or 200000000ns.

data.name: Advanced.PllTip
data.value: PLL parameters separated by colons, for example period=5:phase=60 or period=5:phase=60:lowpass=2.

data.name: Advanced.PrecompTip
data.value: Write precompensation, for example type=mfm:40=125. Types: mfm, fm, gcr; values are in nanoseconds.

data.name: Advanced.DiskDefsTip
data.value: Use a custom diskdefs.cfg file to add or override Greaseweazle format definitions.

data.name: Advanced.RevsTip
data.value: --revs: Number of revolutions read per track. Example: --revs 5.

data.name: Advanced.RetriesTip
data.value: --retries: Additional attempts after an error. Example: --retries 3.

data.name: Advanced.TracksTip
data.value: --tracks: Limit cylinders, heads, or stepping. Example: --tracks c=0-79:h=0-1.

data.name: Advanced.SeekRetriesTip
data.value: --seek-retries: Additional attempts after moving the head. Example: --seek-retries 2.

data.name: Advanced.FakeIndexTip
data.value: --fake-index: Create a timed index for a drive without an index signal. Example: --fake-index 300rpm.

data.name: Advanced.HardSectorsTip
data.value: --hard-sectors: Handle a hard-sectored disk. Incompatible with --fake-index.

data.name: Advanced.ReverseTip
data.value: --reverse: Reverse track data for flippy media or wiring.

data.name: Advanced.AdjustSpeedTip
data.value: --adjust-speed: Rescale data timing. Example: --adjust-speed 300rpm.

data.name: Advanced.PllOptionTip
data.value: --pll: Configure the clock-recovery loop. Example: --pll period=5:phase=60.

data.name: Advanced.DenselTip
data.value: --densel: Force the density-select pin high or low. Example: --densel H.

data.name: Advanced.Tg43Tip
data.value: --gen-tg43: Generate the TG43 signal for drives that require it. Incompatible with --densel.

data.name: Advanced.EraseEmptyTip
data.value: --erase-empty: Erase tracks for which the source image contains no data.

data.name: Advanced.PreEraseTip
data.value: --pre-erase: Erase each track before writing it.

data.name: Advanced.PrecompOptionTip
data.value: --precomp: Apply write precompensation. Example: --precomp type=mfm:40=125.

data.name: Advanced.OutputTracksTip
data.value: --out-tracks: Remap tracks in the output image. Example: --out-tracks c=0-79:h=0-1.
